# dsh-lab

Reserved name — in development.

A LabVIEW-style block-diagram view of a live [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) instance: every plugin as a block, every dependency as a wire, unplug preview with blast radius.

即将到来：活着的 dsh 实例的「程序框图」视图——插件是方块、依赖是导线、拔插前预览爆炸半径。

By the authors of `dsh-memory-pyramid`.
